messages:
matt: Heads-up — starting the tenant-index migration at RFC window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Pinned runtime v3.2.1 and migration job v2.7. Can everyone quiesce writes to metadata service before 01:58?
elaine: ack, quiescing feature flags that touch metadata at 01:55. I’ll post when traffic is at 0r/s.
raj: quick question — autoscaler is on for the dedicated pool, any chance of scale spikes interfering with the backfill?
matt: autoscaler will be disabled for this pool during the window (per release notes). We keep a small pause to avoid node churn while applying index.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] migration-scheduler: scheduled migration tenant-index-2026-03-21 at 1725554321, pinned image=redwood/mig:v2.7, runtime=v3.2.1. canary=3 tenants.
elaine: deploy-bot output looks good. canary tenants green on 3.2.1 in canary-region-1.
anne: rolling backfills start after index apply, right? plan doc said apply index -> backfill rows -> validate checksums -> unquiesce.
matt: correct. backfill workers auto-shard across 16 workers, backfill job has row-rate cap 5000r/s. rollback criteria: any stalled exclusive lock > 5m OR backfill leading to >15% p99 write latency increase.
kevin: I’ll be on call for the window. If we hit the lock threshold I can kill the backfill and requeue later. Is there an escape hatch for partial index apply?
raj: partial apply is risky for this schema — we prefer pause & rollback backfill only, not index.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] migration-runner: canary-1 index-apply started on host gpu-12, logs -> https://ci.redwood/mig/1725554321/logs
elaine: canary index apply completed, no locks seen. canary backfill started.
kevin: seeing slight p99 write blips (from metrics) but under threshold.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] alert: long-running lock detected on table tenant_metadata, lock-age=6m 12s, holder=bg_writer-17, tx=0x8f4a
anne: omg lock >5m. I’m pausing the rollout. matt, do we want to kill backfill?
matt: pause. holdpoint in place. Do not proceed with index apply to rest of tenants. kevin, if you can kill backfill and clear lock holder that’s the move.
kevin: killing backfill worker group id=tbw-4487 now.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] action: backfill-group tbw-4487 terminated by kevin at 1725554550.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] info: lock released at 1725554562, table tenant_metadata now accessible.
raj: thanks. Suggest we extend quiet window by 30m and re-run backfill with more conservative rate cap (2k r/s) and improved batching.
matt: agree. extending window to 04:30 UTC. change noted in release notes: "extended quiet window due to transient lock during canary backfill; backfill re-run with 2k r/s and batching=128".
elaine: I’ll update ops-runbook + release notes and add the rollback reasoning.
kevin: will monitor the first 10m of re-run and escalate if p99 > baseline * 1.12.
anne: add a postmortem blurb: root cause likely background compaction (bg_writer) overlapping with long backfill write bursts. Recommend scheduling compaction outside quiet window.
matt: good call. We’ll schedule compaction jobs to avoid overlap. For now, migration is paused and only will resume after 04:00 UTC holdpoint check-in.
elaine: acknowledged. tagging infra for compaction schedule: @raj FYI. :thumbsup:
raj: cc infra team. I’ll file a small ops ticket to move compaction window.
kevin: everyone ok with the rollback decision? we rolled back only the backfill, kept index apply for canary only.
anne: yes. documented.
matt: final: migrate plan -> paused at stage: post-canary backfill. rollback action taken: terminated backfill workers, extended quiet window, updated release notes. resume only after explicit ops + eng signoff. :white_check_mark:
